professionalCase.title: From a process that took days to one completed in hours
professionalCase.problem: An operational process depended on different information sources, validations, and manual steps that required coordination among several parties.
professionalCase.decision: The process was mapped end to end to identify bottlenecks, clarify handoffs, and remove steps that did not add control or value.
professionalCase.solution: Automations, data transformations, and validations were added to reduce manual work and make each step easier to trace.
professionalCase.result: A process that took several days was completed in a matter of hours.
professionalCase.cta: Do you have a similar process?

experienceSummary.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm Marco Galván, a software developer focused on building and growing my own products. My long-term goal is to develop and sell a portfolio of SaaS products.
My professional experience includes working with teams on digital products, architecture, integrations and software development. That experience also shapes how I build my own products.
I also work with companies that need to build or improve software. I care about understanding the problem, making product decisions and supporting what I build after it goes live.
